items.title: AFFORDABILITY = TRUMP’S ACHILLES HEEL.
items.content:
AFFORDABILITY = TRUMP’S ACHILLES HEEL.Hedgeye (@Hedgeye)🥩 Beef prices are soaring:

The average pound of ground beef hit a record $6.89 in July, up +83% from its 2017 low and above $6 for the first time in history.

Steak now averages $13.06 a pound, up +10% year-over-year.

The root cause is a supply backdrop that's the tightest in three generations:

The U.S. cattle herd has shrunk to 86.2 million head, the smallest since 1951.

And the U.S. just imported a record 2.5 million metric tons of foreign beef, the most in at least 65 years, to fill the gap.

With the USDA not expecting the herd to recover until 2028, relief is years away.

Red meat prices are udderly insane.—  https://x.com/Hedgeye/status/2091116168463393074 
— Steve Hanke (@steve_hanke) Aug 23, 2026
